walkthrough.ending-flow.portal: Equip Soulcleaver on a party member with at least 8 Strength. Wait until Torren stands in front of the portal, then use Void Pulse to push him onto the trigger tile at (-1, -12).
walkthrough.ending-flow.replay: You can see all four endings without starting a new game. Change your dialogue choices, or drop Soulcleaver before the conversation to take a different branch.
walkthrough.ending-flow.summary: Climb from the tower entrance to the fifth floor to meet the Archmage. The fate of the three guardians and your choices determine which of the four endings you reach.

walkthrough.story-flow.description: Obtain the Wolf Skull in the cemetery, and after placing it back in the Caerlin Woods statue, enter the Duskhollow Woods. The dwarves provide clues to the Dragon's Nest and the Reinforced Pickaxe needed to investigate the collapsed obelisks. Having met Torren in the village and read about the underground obelisks, you can purchase the fourth piece in front of the tower. The four pieces of runes open the tower gate, and the Soul Forging furnace side storyline leads to the Soulcleaver.
